## WORKAROUND (verified) — unblock any session in one env var, no code change

**P0 stopgap while the permanent fix lands.** If your gate run dies with 400 `ValidationException` ("Grammar compilation timed out" / "Schema is too complex") at `review@then/prerequisite_verify` after ~185s, with `blocking: 0` and an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict:

    export REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_MODEL="bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8"

Export it in the SAME shell that runs `rebar` (and inside any nohup/background wrapper), then re-run the gate normally.

**Why it works.** Only models carrying a `native_structured_output` row are affected — `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` and `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0`. Those route NativeOutput, which sends Bedrock a JSON Schema to compile into a decoding grammar; the Pass-2 verification contracts (22-36 optional parameters) exceed Anthropic's documented grammar-complexity budget and hit its 180s compile timeout. `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8` is a deliberate NON-row (native=False), so it stays on the prompted path and no grammar is ever compiled. The failing steps are pinned `model: standard`, and `REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL` outranks the config table (`llm/model_classes.py:118-172`).

**Verified, not assumed** (live, us-east-1, same contract both ways):

    plan_review_verification (31 optional)  sonnet-4-6  NATIVE    FAIL 185.3s (400)
    plan_review_verification (31 optional)  opus-4-8    PROMPTED  OK      7.8s

Also confirmed `resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS)` honours the env var, and that opus-4-8 carries `supports_temperature: False` so rebar will not send the `temperature: 0` those steps set (which would be a DIFFERENT 400 on that model).

**Confirm it took effect** — the run log must show:

    llm call [plan-review-prerequisite-verifier] mode=single_turn model=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8

If it still names sonnet-4-6, the export did not reach the process.

**Caveats**
* opus-4-8 is the FRONTIER model: slower and more expensive per gate run. Stopgap, not a new default — revert once the permanent fix lands.
* Do NOT point `standard` at `haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0`; it carries the same native row and fails identically.
* Leave `REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_MODEL` alone — trivial-class steps bind small contracts (459-722 B) that compile fine.
* No `--force` needed: this makes the gate genuinely RUN, so an attestation earned under it is real, not bypassed.

Known blocked by this: [rebar:c827-2a23-cd00-473e], [rebar:70bc-ab05-6d4c-45a0], [rebar:e1b1-859e-a7b4-48f2], [rebar:fd84-92b4-01ba-4911], [rebar:aec1-76e7-bb95-4c86] and any run pinned to the standard class.
